description.content: The Basic Reference package contains the core data required to identify a company, stock, and specific listing of that stock. Data includes items such as ISINs (excluding those issued by CUSIP Global Services), trading symbols, details of the exchange on which the stock is listed, Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI), and the Securities and Exchange Commission’s Central Index Key. Most recent data supported.

description.content:
Use the `oauth` endpoint to generate the secure, time-limited JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) used to authorize access to APIs and components.</br></br>
To request a token, click Authorize and enter the following credentials:

* Username - Your Client ID.
* Password - Your Client Secret.
